rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable without reducing coverage or making unsupported assumptions. The workflow already caches pip dependencies via actions/setup-python cache: "pip" in every job that installs Python packages (build_dist, test_source, test_wheel), which is the same dependency-cache optimization described by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; adding a separate actions/cache for ~/.cache/pip is contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST would cancel remaining matrix cells, but the workflow explicitly sets fail-fast: false to preserve full matrix coverage, so changing it conflicts with preserving intended build and test coverage. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE conflicts with the release/publish job (release/deployment work is a listed contraindication). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not safely supported: only whole-run history is available, not per-job successful-duration history, and cold installs of optional heavy extras (sentence-transformers/torch via [embeddings]) on macOS and Windows risk false timeouts on valid slow runs. No other pattern's preconditions are met without unrelated or coverage-reducing changes.
